svg.title: dsh-import-customs-check structure: one document set, two independent channels, nine fields and twelve elements
svg.desc: A tall import-set.json card lists the four documents with their real field coverage: invoice 9/9, packing list 5/9, bill of lading 5/9, customs declaration 9/9, read-only and up to 5 MB. It feeds two channels that never mix. Channel A is the nine-field consistency scoreboard: normalise first (uppercase, collapse spaces, strip dots and hyphens from the HS code, 0.001 kg and 0.01 half-up), then each field lands in exactly one of four states; the fixture gives 8 consistent and 1 mismatch (gross weight 2450.50 on the declaration against 2450.00 three times), so pass=false and strict=true would raise E_IMPORT_FIELD_MISMATCH. Channel B is the declaration twelve-slot element strip: 11 present, port_of_loading missing, complete=false, and this never changes pass. Only channel A reaches import_export, which writes 9 CSV rows with a sha256 under $DSH_HOME/dsh-import-customs-check/exports/.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: 一份单证集，两条独立通道：A 判 9 个字段是否一致，B 点报关单 12 项要素缺哪项；只有对照表能导出 CSV。
